summary: This standard covers companies that lend to consumers, mainly through credit cards, and may also offer auto, micro and student loans, money transfers and pre-paid cards. Disclosure topics are customer privacy, data security and selling practices.

questions.text: How many account holders had their information used for secondary purposes?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of account holders whose information was used for purposes other than those it was collected for.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses as a result of legal proceedings associated with customer privacy?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total monetary losses in your presentation currency for the reporting period.

questions.text: What are (1) the number of data breaches, (2) the percentage that were personal data breaches, and (3) the number of account holders affected?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Percentage (%) · Report (1) a count, (2) a percentage and (3) a count of account holders affected; answer each part separately.

questions.text: What were your card-related fraud losses from (1) card-not-present fraud and (2) card-present and other fraud?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report each loss amount separately in your presentation currency.

questions.text: How does your organisation identify and address data security risks?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe the approach to identifying risks, the controls and standards used, and how risks are addressed.

questions.text: What percentage of total remuneration for covered employees is variable and linked to the amount of products and services sold?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report a percentage (0 to 100); note which employees are treated as covered.

questions.text: What is your approval rate for (1) credit and (2) pre-paid products for applicants?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) · Report an approval percentage for each of the two product types.

questions.text: What are (1) your average fees from add-on products, (2) average APR of credit products, (3) average age of credit products, (4) average number of credit accounts, and (5) average annual fees for pre-paid products?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency, Percentage (%), Months, Number · Give each value separately: (1) and (5) in presentation currency, (2) as a percentage, (3) in months, (4) as a number.

questions.text: What are (1) the number of customer complaints filed and (2) the percentage with monetary or non-monetary relief?
questions.hint: Unit: Number, Percentage (%) · Report (1) a count of complaints and (2) the percentage that resulted in relief.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses as a result of legal proceedings associated with the selling and servicing of products?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total monetary losses in your presentation currency for the reporting period.

questions.text: How many unique consumers have an active (1) credit card account and (2) pre-paid debit card account?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report a count of unique consumers for each of the two account types.

questions.text: How many (1) credit card accounts and (2) pre-paid debit card accounts do you have?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report a count of accounts for each of the two account types.
